python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
pages = [Path('docs/adrs/0002-keep-background-jobs-in-postgres.md'), Path('docs/adrs/README.md'), Path('docs/architecture.md')]
for page in pages:
    for target in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)', page.read_text()):
        name, _, anchor = target.partition('#')
        dest = page.parent / name
        assert dest.is_file(), (page, target)
        if anchor:
            headings = re.findall(r'^#+ (.+)$', dest.read_text(), re.M)
            assert anchor in [re.sub(r'[^\w -]', '', h.lower()).replace(' ', '-') for h in headings], (page, target)
print('Links in changed pages resolve.')
PY
